<script>
(function () {
  function initIndexPage() {
    var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-compass-target]');
    var panels = document.querySelectorAll('.cagp-compass-panel');

    function activateTab(targetId, updateHash) {
      if (updateHash === undefined) updateHash = true;
      var activeTab = document.querySelector('[data-compass-target="' + targetId + '"]');
      if (!activeTab) return;

      tabs.forEach(function (t) { t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
      panels.forEach(function (p) { p.hidden = true; });

      activeTab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
      var targetPanel = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (targetPanel) targetPanel.hidden = false;

      if (updateHash) {
        var hashKey = targetId.replace('panel-', '');
        history.replaceState(null, '', '#bussola=' + hashKey);
      }
    }

    tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
      tab.onclick = function () {
        var targetId = tab.getAttribute('data-compass-target');
        activateTab(targetId);
      };

      tab.onkeydown = function (e) {
        var tabList = Array.from(tabs);
        var index = tabList.indexOf(tab);
        var nextIndex = null;

        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
          nextIndex = (index + 1) % tabList.length;
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
          nextIndex = (index - 1 + tabList.length) % tabList.length;
        } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
          nextIndex = 0;
        } else if (e.key === 'End') {
          nextIndex = tabList.length - 1;
        }

        if (nextIndex !== null) {
          e.preventDefault();
          tabList[nextIndex].focus();
          var nextTargetId = tabList[nextIndex].getAttribute('data-compass-target');
          activateTab(nextTargetId);
        }
      };
    });

    function checkHash() {
      var hash = window.location.hash;
      if (hash && hash.indexOf('#bussola=') === 0) {
        var key = hash.replace('#bussola=', '');
        var targetPanelId = 'panel-' + key;
        activateTab(targetPanelId, false);
        var bussolaSection = document.getElementById('bussola-interativa');
        if (bussolaSection) {
          bussolaSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      }
    }

    function syncCompassWithProfile() {
      if (window.location.hash && window.location.hash.indexOf('#bussola=') === 0) return;
      try {
        var rawProf = localStorage.getItem('cagp_student_profile_v1');
        if (!rawProf) return;
        var prof = JSON.parse(rawProf);
        if (!prof || !prof.period) return;
        var pNum = parseInt(prof.period, 10);
        var targetPanel = 'panel-calouro';
        if (prof.period === 'egresso' || pNum >= 7) {
          targetPanel = 'panel-formando';
        } else if (pNum >= 2 && pNum <= 6) {
          targetPanel = 'panel-meio';
        } else {
          targetPanel = 'panel-calouro';
        }
        activateTab(targetPanel, false);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    checkHash();
    syncCompassWithProfile();
    if (window.refreshCagpVault) window.refreshCagpVault();

    if (window.__cagpIndexProfileListener) {
      window.removeEventListener('cagp:profile-updated', window.__cagpIndexProfileListener);
    }
    window.__cagpIndexProfileListener = function () {
      syncCompassWithProfile();
    };
    window.addEventListener('cagp:profile-updated', window.__cagpIndexProfileListener);

    var onboardBanner = document.getElementById('cagp-onboarding-banner');
    var btnDismissOnboard = document.getElementById('btn-dismiss-onboard');
    if (onboardBanner && btnDismissOnboard) {
      try {
        if (localStorage.getItem('cagp_onboard_v1_dismissed') === 'true') {
          onboardBanner.style.display = 'none';
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      btnDismissOnboard.onclick = function () {
        onboardBanner.style.display = 'none';
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('cagp_onboard_v1_dismissed', 'true');
        } catch (e) {}
      };
    }

    var filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.cagp-app-filter-btn');
    var appCards = document.querySelectorAll('.cagp-app-card');

    filterButtons.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function () {
        filterButtons.forEach(function (b) {
          b.classList.remove('is-active');
          b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
        });
        btn.classList.add('is-active');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');

        var filter = btn.getAttribute('data-app-filter');
        appCards.forEach(function (card) {
          if (filter === 'all') {
            card.style.display = 'flex';
          } else {
            var cardCat = card.getAttribute('data-app-cat') || '';
            card.style.display = cardCat.indexOf(filter) !== -1 ? 'flex' : 'none';
          }
        });
      };
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initIndexPage, { once: true });
  } else {
    initIndexPage();
  }
})();
</script>
